intro: Menethil Harbor is a heavily fortified dwarven port town perched on an island off the western shore of the Wetlands. Named after King Terenas Menethil II, it acts as the primary maritime lifeline connecting the Eastern Kingdoms to the distant shores of Kalimdor. Sheltered behind massive stone battlements and the sturdy towers of Menethil Keep, it is a bustling hub for merchants, off-duty soldiers, and salty adventurers.

p: Named in tribute to King Terenas Menethil II of Lordaeron, Menethil Harbor stands as a premier Alliance haven on the Wetlands coast. Despite its remote marshland setting, it remains a heavily defended bastion, reinforced by massive walls, a single bridged causeway, and the four stone watchtowers of Menethil Keep.

Today, the harbor is the grand crossroads of the Alliance. Ships steam continually across the ocean toward Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh and, by way of Southshore, Auberdine in Darkshore, carrying trade, diplomats, and off-duty Kul Tiran marines blowing their wages at the Deepwater Tavern. Yet peace is fragile here: inland supply paths through Dun Algaz are regularly contested by the Dragonmaw clan, while hostile Dark Iron raiders pressure the northern marshes, leaving Captain Stoutfist and the harbor garrison on constant alert.
